images.caption: Poster for public meeting on 1945-06-24 Skamlingsbanken, on the occasion of the liberation and the end of World War II. It was the resistance movement's Region 3, who organized the meeting and was attended by  approx. 80,000 people. There were speeches by many different people, including 3 ministers; Frode Jakobsen, Mogens Fog and Aksel Larsen. During the festival there were bonfires, show of British troops and several artists and dancers from the Danish Royal Theatre.
